title: Businessweek Live at Bloomberg Invest | Bloomberg Businessweek Daily 3/03/2026
content: On today's episode of Bloomberg Businessweek Daily, Carol Massar and Tim Stenovec discuss a risk-off move gripping markets to start Tuesday as investors digest Iran war headwinds. Brookfield Asset Management CEO Connor Teskey weighs in from Bloomberg Invest, and also discusses the state of private credit. Then, Bloomberg's Eric Weiner recaps today's price action as stocks and bonds sink and oil rallies. Plus, NYSE President Lynn Martin weighs in on the IPO backdrop as candidates look to get deals done amid geopolitical uncertainty. Next, MongoDB CEO CJ Desai on the company's recent earnings and investor worries as the stock sinks as far as 20% Tuesday. Finally, Ariel Investments Founder & CEO John Rogers on value investing and the US consumer. (Source: Bloomberg)
